objective: Create the clean blocked Math 10C Chapter 4 static learner shell from the approved production contract, matching the established Chapter 3 navigation and presentation conventions without implementing mastery scoring or saved-state logic.
acceptanceCriteria: The blocked local project has overview, before-you-begin, eight lesson, practice/review, reference, resources and retained-work routes.
Lesson headings and target lists exactly reflect the 32 targets in the production contract.
Navigation, responsive sidebar, reference panel and page switching follow the established Chapter 3 presentation pattern.
The learner shell makes no mastery, grade, SCORM, Brightspace, accessibility or release claim.
Formal assessments, answer keys and EOL content are absent from learner pages.
No scoring, checking or saved-state logic is invented; placeholders clearly say those contracts remain under implementation.
requiredChecks: Verify that all route IDs u4-overview, u4-ready, u4-41 through u4-48, u4-practice, u4-review, u4-reference, u4-resources and u4-work occur in the workspace.
Verify that all 32 target IDs C4-41a through C4-48d occur exactly once in the learner source.
deferredChecks: Mathematical checker tests after lead implementation
Saved-state and capacity tests after lead implementation
SCORM, Brightspace, accessibility and teacher review
prohibitedChanges: Do not edit Chapter 3, production contracts, raw sources, exports, runtime caches, active handoffs or unrelated files.
Do not implement or claim mastery scoring, mathematical correctness, saved-state compatibility, SCORM readiness or release readiness.
Do not copy formal assessments, answer keys, quiz images or EOL prompts into the learner shell.
Do not commit, push, package, deploy, publish or change branches.
